chose: How the filter icon and the overview of C1160 behave. The icon's popover closes on a pick, an outside click or Escape, and while the list is narrowed or reordered the icon carries a dot and a short line beside it says what is set, so a narrowed list is never hidden. The overview draws every stop of every train: passed stops in the done colour, stops ahead neutral (the owner's ahead dashed), and each train's current stop by C1119's holder × urgency; and marks the selected train's row and its active stop with a solid ring in the ink colour, never dashed, so the mark is not read as C1119's whenever. A tap on a stop in the overview makes it the card's, and moves the list to that train's page when the owner's filter shows it; it never changes the owner's filter or order, so when the filter hides that train the card shows it while the list stays as the owner set it.
